Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

response.rationale: A and B look like the same thing: a skating session at an ice rink that people book. In A, `BookingRepository.findBySession(sessionId: string)` finds bookings by session. In B, `BookingService` loads `this.sessions.findById(input.sessionId)` using the same `sessionId` key on bookings, through `SessionRepository.findById` in the graph. Both code paths are in the same booking area of an ice-rink system (the graph shows IceMonitorService, HireStockRepository and SessionService.availability). So "Session" and "Skating Session" are two names for one concept, not two concepts that just happen to share an id.
